question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Build the full query: for each (constructor, year), find best driver points and combined total
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_final AS (
  SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_final AS (
  SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.year, dr.driver_id, dr.constructor_id
  FROM drives dr
  WHERE dr.constructor_id > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points, 
         MAX(df.driver_points) as best_driver_points
  FROM driver_constructors dc
  JOIN constructor_final cf ON dc.constructor_id = cf.constructor_id AND dc.year = cf.year
  JOIN driver_final df ON dc.driver_id = df.driver_id AND dc.year = df.year
  GROUP BY dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.name as constructor_name, 
         co.year,
         co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points as combined_points
  FROM combined co
  JOIN constructors c ON co.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM ranked
ORDER BY combined_points DESC

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build the full query: for each (constructor, year), find best driver points and combined total
WITH last_races AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_final AS (
  SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_final AS (
  SELECT ds.driver_id, lr.year, ds.points as driver_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
driver_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.year, dr.driver_id, dr.constructor_id
  FROM drives dr
  WHERE dr.constructor_id > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points, 
         MAX(df.driver_points) as best_driver_points
  FROM driver_constructors dc
  JOIN constructor_final cf ON dc.constructor_id = cf.constructor_id AND dc.year = cf.year
  JOIN driver_final df ON dc.driver_id = df.driver_id AND dc.year = df.year
  GROUP BY dc.constructor_id, dc.year, cf.constructor_points
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.name as constructor_name, 
         co.year,
         co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points as combined_points
  FROM combined co
  JOIN constructors c ON co.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.constructor_points + co.best_driver_points DESC) <= 3
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM ranked
ORDER BY combined_points DESC", "preview_rows": 10}
